description: This file defines culture-specific information for the Malay (Brunei) locale in the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for date parsing, and helper functions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week from its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month from its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the abbreviation of a timezone offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a timezone name.
